title: Athletic Mind participation and automated support processing
body:
By joining this Athletic Mind program, you agree that PulseCheck and AuntEdna systems will automatically process your current onboarding answers, new check-ins, and the full text of new Nora conversations created after you accept these terms. They use this information to support you and look for signs that you may need help. This processing is part of program participation. It may happen during a scheduled daily exchange or when AuntEdna requests an update. Earlier Nora conversations are outside this permission.

Moving information between these systems is separate from sharing it with people around you. Sharing a private conversation or health concern with a coach, trainer, parent, or team clinician requires your permission for that situation, identifying the person and information to be shared. During an emergency, PulseCheck sends the information needed for the handoff to AuntEdna. AuntEdna handles clinical recipient selection, assignment, and after-hours response through its clinical service. Coaches are outside that emergency disclosure route.

Authorized company personnel may access information for service operations, support, security, and incident investigation as permitted by their assigned duties and applicable agreements. Automated processing does not mean that no person can ever access the information.

Wearables and private journal sharing remain separate choices. Your existing choices stay in place. Research and any required health-information authorization remain separate decisions. Participant data must not be sold or used for unrelated advertising. Restricted clinical or mental-health information must not be used for independent model training, commercial profiling, or unrelated product development.

Participation is voluntary. You may decline or stop without affecting team status, scholarship, playing time, medical care, or academic standing. Contact your program’s privacy contact to stop participation or request help with your information choices. Future automated exchanges stop when participation or this permission is withdrawn. Previously permitted processing and retention remain subject to the applicable program agreements and law.

AI responses and derived summaries can be inaccurate. The platforms are not emergency response services. During an emergency, call 911, call or text 988, or use your institution’s urgent support resources. You retain your legal rights.
